description.narrative:
The project "Weaving Advocacy for Rights" will be developed at the national level in Colombia for 39 months. Its objective is to strengthen the capacities of articulation, advocacy and sustainability of a national network, made up of more than 150 civil social organizations that work in the comprehensive defense of Economic, Social, Cultural and Environmental Rights, with an emphasis on climate justice, the right to a healthy environment and food sovereignty.
Political training, knowledge production, organizational articulation and strategic communication actions will be implemented, with a special focus on the participation of women and youth (at least 60% women and 30% young people among the direct beneficiaries). Regional capacities, advocacy on public policies and the visibility of territorial leadership will be prioritized.
